description: This Java class 'MessageCommandResponseSignalMapper' extends an abstract class to map message command responses into signals, extracting subject, status code, and message headers from 'MessageCommandResponse' objects.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps 'MessageCommandResponse' objects to signals by extracting key message components.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject string from the message command response.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the optional HTTP status code from the message command response.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Extracts the message headers from the response's message.
